headline: [Record IPO!] Claude Maker Anthropic Raises [$81.3 Billion] Before Nasdaq Debut
sub: Shares priced at $83, trading starts Thursday
caption:
💰 Record IPO! Claude Maker Anthropic Raises $81.3 Billion Before Nasdaq Debut

AI company Anthropic, the maker of the Claude chatbot, priced its stock market listing at $83 per share on Wednesday. Reuters and Bloomberg report it is the biggest stock market debut on record. The shares start trading on the Nasdaq on Thursday, November 19.

🔹 The $83 price is above the first planned range of $70 to $78 per share.
🔹 The listing raises $81.3 billion, beating SpaceX's record debut in June. With a $26 billion private sale added, the total deal is $107.3 billion.
🔹 Reuters reports this values Anthropic at about $1.5 trillion (fully diluted). It is the first major frontier AI model maker to go public.

💬 Would you buy shares in an AI company? 👇

Sources: Reuters, Bloomberg

headline: [Loud Blast!] Houthi Missile Intercepted Over [Riyadh] as Debris Causes Damage
sub: No casualties reported, damage being assessed
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Houthi Missile Intercepted Over Riyadh as Debris Causes Damage

A missile fired by Yemen's Houthis toward Riyadh was intercepted early on Thursday, November 19, the Saudi-led coalition said. A loud boom was heard across the Saudi capital after a civil defence alert. Falling debris caused material damage, and no casualties were reported.

🔹 Civil defence sent a phone alert at 4:42 a.m. local time and said a few minutes later that the danger had passed.
🔹 The coalition also said it destroyed a Houthi cruise missile aimed at southern Saudi Arabia. The Houthis claimed they targeted Riyadh's King Khalid airport and financial centre; Saudi authorities have not confirmed this.
🔹 Fighting between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis has grown in recent weeks, breaking a 2022 UN-backed truce. The extent of the damage is still being assessed.

💬 Do you think the 2022 truce can be saved? 👇

Sources: Reuters, Arab News

headline: [Making History!] Trump, Xi and Putin Meet for Rare [Three-Way Talks]
sub: Nuclear weapons, wars and trade on the table
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Trump, Xi and Putin Meet for Rare Three-Way Talks

US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin met together on Thursday, November 19, at the APEC summit in Shenzhen, China. AP reports the three-way meeting began in the afternoon, after Trump held separate one-on-one talks with Xi and Putin.

🔹 Trump said: "We are really making history." He said the three countries are "uniquely positioned to discuss how to reduce the number of nuclear weapons on Earth."
🔹 AP reports Trump's talks with Xi lasted about an hour, and with Putin about 40 minutes.
🔹 Nuclear weapons and the wars in Iran and Ukraine are expected to top the agenda. No agreement has been announced yet.

💬 Can talks like this make the world safer? 👇

Sources: AP, CNBC

#GlobalEye #Trump #XiJinping #Putin #APEC #Shenzhen
photo_needed: Trump, Xi Jinping and Putin together at the APEC summit in Shenzhen (all faces clearly visible), or any two of them shaking hands there. A big, clear, landscape photo works best.

headline: [Landmark Ruling!] UN Top Court Finds Myanmar Committed [Genocide] Against Rohingya
sub: First time the court rules a state committed genocide
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: UN Top Court Finds Myanmar Committed Genocide Against Rohingya

The International Court of Justice (ICJ), the UN's top court in The Hague, ruled on Thursday, November 19, that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya Muslim minority in 2017. AP reports the judges voted 9-6. It is the first time the court has ruled that a state committed genocide.

🔹 Court President Yuji Iwasawa said security forces killed thousands of Rohingya civilians. The court said evidence showed about 10,000 Rohingya were killed.
🔹 More than 730,000 Rohingya fled to Bangladesh during the 2017 crackdown. The court rejected Myanmar's claim that it was a legal operation against armed fighters.
🔹 The Gambia brought the case in 2019. The court cannot enforce its ruling by itself; it can report non-compliance to the UN Security Council.

💬 Will this ruling bring justice for the Rohingya? 👇

Sources: AP, Reuters, Al Jazeera

#GlobalEye #ICJ #Myanmar #Rohingya #Gambia #Bangladesh
